mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening consumer demand, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances following 2-month HOUST acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns are likely to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns remain positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (labor market strength) and low UNRATE (< 4.0%) indicates sustained economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO signals weakening supply chains, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to potential production shortfalls.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating increased consumer spending, S&P 500 forward returns are likely to be positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 55% of instances when RSAFS > 6mo MA.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (< 2.0%) and rising CPIAUCSL (> 2.5% YoY) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) under the specified conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden 0.5% increase in UNRATE within 2 months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns remain positive in > 58% of instances following a 0.5% UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 growth exceeding 3.5% YoY indicates robust economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.
